latest.title: The Crystal Bunker: Engineering a Highly Automated WAFR with Kiro and the AWS "Nervous System"
latest.description: In Latin America, engineers face a "hybrid paradox": craving AWS elasticity while tethered to on-premises legacy workloads on vCenter or Hyper-V. Our role is ensuring the "Crystal Bunker"—a transparent yet impenetrable architecture—remains sound. Using Kiro and AWS MCP Servers, we transformed a two-week manual WAFR into a two-hour deep-dive, identifying 39 findings and remediating 21 within 50 days. This strategy amplifies human judgment through AI-driven operational symmetry.
